verdict: Leads are up and cost per lead is falling, but none are reaching your pipeline.
narrative: This period, your Meta campaign delivered 171 leads at an average cost of $12.32 per lead — and over the most recent week, cost per lead dropped 12.55% while lead volume rose 12.82%, meaning the campaign is becoming more efficient. The problem is downstream: 171 leads arrived in 28 days, but zero have been routed into your pipeline, pointing to an intake and CRM routing issue rather than anything wrong with the ads. Your Google Business Profile engagement also dropped sharply this week, with local actions effectively going quiet over the last three days. We are actively working to resolve the CRM routing failure and restore your local profile activity so that the leads your ads are generating start converting into trackable pipeline opportunities.
